title: Keep the current project in the list
responsibility: Reads the connection’s project list and ensures the currently shown project appears in the project switcher.

inputs.name: listedProjects.bridge
inputs.description: The desktop connection, optionally offering a project-list operation. An older connection without that operation is accepted.

inputs.name: projectList.projects
inputs.description: The projects already listed, in display order. Existing entries are kept as supplied, including their names and any duplicates.

inputs.name: projectList.snapshot
inputs.description: The shown project snapshot, or null when no project is shown. Its identity is used to avoid appending it again; an absent identity is represented by an empty string.

outputs.name: listedProjects
outputs.description: A promise for the connection’s listed projects, or an empty list when the operation is absent. A failure from the listing operation is passed back as a rejected promise.

outputs.name: projectList
outputs.description: The original list when there is no snapshot or its project identity is already present. Otherwise a new list appends the shown project with its name and identity. A GitHub-backed snapshot is marked shared; all other snapshots are marked local.
